title: glandularia tristachya
intro: Glandularia tristachya, commonly known as Prairie Sage, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, particularly for its benefits to the respiratory system. The health benefits of Glandularia tristachya include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs and colds, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which can help to fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, while its bioactive constituents include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
